Please identify yourself, Haulcraft.''"
"''Sorry, can you repeat back please?''"
"''This is an Imperial patrol. Standby for transponder scan.|Captain Elk and Luthen Rael|audio=Elk-Rael-Patrol.flac|}} '''Elk''' was a [[human]] [[captain]] in the [[Imperial Navy]] who [[Commanding officer|commanded]] a [[Cantwell-class Arrestor Cruiser|''Cantwell''-class Arrestor Cruiser]] as part of the [[Segra-Milo Imperial patrol]]. In [[5 BBY]], his [[cruiser]] [[Skirmish above Segra Milo|encountered]] the [[Luthen Rael's Fondor Haulcraft|Fondor Haulcraft]] of the [[Axis network|rebel]] [[Luthen Rael]] above the [[planet]] [[Segra Milo]]. Elk commanded Rael to provide a [[Transponder code|transponder ID]] but had a boarding party prepared as they waited for the ID to be checked. He ordered the [[V-21.1 Chevlex light haulcraft|haulcraft]] to be held using [[Elk's Cantwell-class Arrestor Cruiser|the cruiser's]] [[tractor beam]] but was shocked when Rael deployed countermeasures that destroyed the Imperial [[Starship|vessel's]] forward tractor dish. He then could only watch as the rebel destroyed the four [[TIE series|TIE vessels]] deployed from the cruiser before jumping to [[hyperspace]]. ==Biography== ===Patrol encounter=== {{Quote|Is there something wrong, patrol?''"
"''There's been partisan activity in the area. This is a piracy zone.''"
"''Oh, thank you for the warning. I'll be careful.''"
"''You'll be standing by is what you'll be doing.|Luthen Rael and Captain Elk|audio=Rael-Elk-SomethingWrong.flac|}} [[File:HaulcraftArrestor-DaughterofFerrix.png|thumb|right|300px|Elk encountered the Fondor Haulcraft of Luthen Rael of Segra Milo.]] [[Captain]] Elk was a [[human]] who served as an [[Imperial officer|officer]] in the [[Imperial Navy's officer corps|officer corps]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Navy]]. By [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|111}} he [[Commanding officer|commanded]] a [[Cantwell-class Arrestor Cruiser|''Cantwell''-class Arrestor Cruiser]] as part of [[Segra-Milo Imperial patrol]]. [[Elk's Cantwell-class Arrestor Cruiser|The vessel]] was tasked with patrolling the [[Realspace|space]] near the [[planet]] [[Segra Milo]], always on the lookout for suspicious activity, as there had been [[Partisans|Partisan]] activity in the area, which was considered a [[Pirate|piracy]] zone. While above Segra Milo that [[Standard year|year]], the [[cruiser]] [[Skirmish above Segra Milo|encountered]] a [[Luthen Rael's Fondor Haulcraft|Fondor Haulcraft]]. Blocking the [[V-21.1 Chevlex light haulcraft|haulcraft's]] transmissions, Elk contacted the [[Starship|ship]] over [[Comm unit|comms]] from the cruiser's [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]], where he stood with his [[Unidentified Imperial executive officer|executive officer]] and [[Unidentified weapons specialist|weapons specialist]]. He identified his patrol before asking for the ship to send over identification. The haulcraft belonged to [[Luthen Rael]], head of a [[Axis network|rebel network]]; Rael had been meeting with the Partisans, who were [[Saw Gerrera's Base|based]] on Segra Milo. To buy [[time]] for his [[Fondor Droid Mod]] to provide a false [[Transponder code|transponder ID]], Rael responded over comms and asked for Elk to repeat himself, and by the time Elk warned Luthen to expect a transponder scan, the rebel had an ID ready for the captain. Elk then had Rael hold as [[Unidentified male pit crew member|one]] of his crew checked the code while the cruiser slowly moved closer to the haulcraft from three clicks away. ===A nasty surprise=== {{Quote|Final warning. Haulcraft. Power down immediately or risk full consequences.|Captain Elk|audio=Elk-FullConsequences.flac|}} [[File:ArrestorOfficers-DaughterofFerrix.png|thumb|left|300px|Elk commanded the crew of a ''Cantwell''-class Arrestor Cruiser.]] As they waited, Rael asked Elk if there was an issue causing him to be checked, thanking the Imperial when Elk informed him of the Partisan and pirate activity nearby; however, the captain ordered the haulcraft to continue waiting and had his crew power on the cruiser's [[tractor beam]], pulling Rael's craft closer. Rael engaged a decoy burn on one of his portside [[Engine|thrusters]], claiming it was overheating when Elk asked him to disengage it. Concerned, Elk had another [[Unidentified pit crew member (Segra-Milo)|crew member]] check the haulcraft's thermals, receiving a report of an aberrant heat signature in the thruster. The captain then ordered his [[executive officer]] to have a boarding team ready, and when this was confirmed, he asked Rael to power down his [[stabilizer]]s. Receiving no response, the captain kept his [[eye]]s on the vessel through his [[viewport]] and demanded confirmation that he had been heard. Rael finally responded, claiming that he was having to manually disengage the stabilizers while he was in fact waiting for his vessel's countermeasures to be prepared. His crew then completed the check on the transponder code that Rael had provided and confirmed it was authentic, but when questioned by his executive officer, Elk told him not to stand down as the boarding party needed the practice. Once he warned Rael that he was to be boarded, the rebel fully activated his engines and attempted to pull away from the tractor beam. [[File:ArrestorShredded-DaughterofFerrix.png|thumb|right|300px|Luthen Rael shredded the forward tractor dish on Elk's Arrestor Cruiser.]] As the cruiser shuddered from still holding the haulcraft, Elk ordered the beam increased by five and issued a final warning to Rael. The rebel's response was to release clouds of shrapnel from his vessel, which were pulled in by the cruiser's tractor beam and shredded its forward tractor dish. Shocked, Elk ordered the cruiser's [[Segra-Milo Imperial patrol's air wing|air wing]] to deploy but could only watch in horror as Rael pulled away from the now deactivated tractor beam and quickly destroyed the three [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]]s and single [[TIE boarding craft]] under the captain's command. Elk glowered as Rael then escaped into [[hyperspace]]. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|No!''"
"''From a haulcraft?|Elk and his executive officer are shocked at the haulcraft's attack|audio=Elk-No.flac|}} Elk had light skin, graying [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], and blue eyes. Vigilant for partisans and piracy, he stopped any suspicious vessels he encountered on patrol, sometimes even detaining and boarding those with valid transponder IDs just for the practice.''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' He was shocked at being bested by Rael and his haulcraft. ==Equipment== {{Quote|Tractor force up five.''"
"''Does he think he can get away?|Elk and his executive officer|audio=Elk-TractorForce.flac|}} Elk wore a black [[Imperial officer's uniform]] including a black [[Imperial kepi|cap]], a black [[belt]], and black [[boot]]s. He bore a [[rank insignia plaque]] with three blue squares and two red and carried a [[code cylinder]] on either side of his chest. He commanded a ''Cantwell''-class cruiser with a tractor beam and an air wing of at least four [[TIE series|TIE vessels]]. ==Behind the scenes== Elk was portrayed by [[Roger Barclay]] in the television show ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', appearing in the [[Andor Season 1|first season's]] eleventh episode, "[[Daughter of Ferrix]]," which aired on [[November 16]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}} The character's name was not spoken in the episode but was used in the credits and subtitles. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Elk|soundcat=Audio files of Elk}} *{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' *{{EncyclopediaCite|Miscellaneous Ships and Vehicles (2)}} {{C|English version only}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Topps|set=2025 Topps Chrome Star Wars|cardname=#16 - Captain Elk|link=https://www.ebay.com/itm/336136617545}} *[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles (second edition)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'', second edition]] *{{Databank|captain-elk|Captain Elk}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Elk |fr=Elk |ja=エルク |ka=ელკი |nl=Elk }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Navy captains of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
